The Police-Sub-Inspector of Giri nagara P.S. has filed chargesheet against Accused no.1 to 3 for the offences punishable U/s.498A, 323 r/w/s 34 of IPC.
 2.
The criminal law has been set into motion based on the first information statement of Smt.Sandya.
The gist of the prosecution case is that the accused No.1 married CW-1 on 01-11- 2012.
After the marriage, CW-1 started residing with the accused.

When CW-1 was staying with the accused , the accused No.1 and 3 along with deceased accused No.2 with common intention used to harass CW-1 mentally and physically for giving birth to a girl baby and subjected CW-1 to cruelty and demanded her to get money from her parents house and drove her away out of the matrimonial house.

It is further alleged that on 02-10-2017 at about 7.30 p.m.,
when the parents of CW-1 came to drop CW-1 at her matrimonial house, the accused no.1 and 3 have assaulted CW-1 and accused No.3 assaulted CW-4 with their hands, causing hurt and again sent  3  C.C.No.29460/2018 CW-1 out of the matrimonial home and thus subjected CW-1 to physical and mental cruelty.
Based on the said information, a case in Cr.No.276/2017 came to be registered against the accused for the aforesaid offences.
3. After completion of the investigation, the P.I of Giri nagara P.S. has filed chargesheet against accused for the aforesaid offences.
On receipt of charge sheet, this court took cognizance of the alleged offences.
Pursuant to the issuance and service of summons, accused entered appearance and were enlarged on bail.

2
The prosecution papers was furnished to the accused as required U/s.207 of Cr.P.C.
During trial of the case, accused No.2 reported as dead hence, case against Accused No.2 stood abated.

4. Before framing charge an opportunity of being heard was provided to the accused No.1 and 3 after hearing them and the prosecution and as there was sufficient materials, the charge for the aforesaid offences was framed and same was read over to the accused in the language known to them, to which, the accused pleaded not guilty and claimed to be tried.
The plea of the accused No.1 was recorded.
Thereafter, the matter was set down for prosecution evidence.
In order to prove the charges, the prosecution has examined PW-1 to PW-3 and got marked Ex.P.1 and P.2 documents.

The statement of accused No.1 and 3 as required U/s.
313 of Cr.P.C. is recorded.
In which the accused No.1 and 3 denied the incriminating circumstances appeared against them.
The accused have not let in any oral or documentary evidence on their behalf.
6. Heard arguments on both the sides.
I have Perused the materials on record.

7. The following points arise for my determination:-
 1) Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable  doubt that the accused persons caused physical and  mental cruelty to the complainant in demand of dowry  and threatened her and thereby accused have committed  the offences punishable U/s.323, 498A r/w/s 34 of IPC.
Sandhya vs Muralidhar.K.G on 4 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/149944323/
3  ?
 2) what order?
 8.

My finding to the above points are as under:-
 Point No.1 ........In the Negative.
 Point No.2........

As per final order, for the following:
 5  C.C.No.29460/2018  REASONS  9. POINT No.1 :- It is the fundamental principle of criminal jurisprudence that the prosecution has to prove its case beyond reasonable doubt.
In order to bring home the guilt of the accused

,
the prosecution has examined three witnesses as PW-1 to PW-3 got marked Ex.P.1 and Ex.P2 documents.
Ex.P1 is the first information statement.
Ex . P.2
is the spot panchanama.
10. CW-1 was examined as P.W.-1 Sandhya.

She has deposed in her examination-in-chief that her marriage was performed with the accused No.1 on 01-11-2012 at Ambika Kalyana mantapa,
Kengeri .
After the marriage she started residing with accused at Veerabhadranagar.
After a year of marriage, she gave birth to a female child at her parents house.
Afterwards, accused did not visit her.
PW-1 further deposed that after convincing her by CW-4 and her husband, she was sent to her husband house.
Accused used to picked up quarrel for petty matters and use to abuse her as she has not brought anything at the time of marriage.
In the year 2017 she gave birth to second female child, accused have abused as she had begotten another female child.
PW-1 further deposed that she

6 Sandhya vs Muralidhar.K.G on 4 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/149944323/
4  C.C.No.29460/2018 went to the police station to lodge complaint.
The Police have called accused and advised and told to join husband house within 3 months.
After 3 months herself, CW 4 and 5 came to house of accused at 5 00 pm, mother of the Accused No.1 made them to wait till Accused No.1 come home.
At 7.30 p.m. the Accused No.1 and 3 arrived and accused have assaulted CW-1 and CW-4 by dragging on road, they went to the hospital.
Later they went to police station and lodged complaint, police visited the spot and conducted mahazar at Ex.P.2.
During her cross examination she has turned fully hostile to the case of the prosecution and denied her entire chief examination allegation.
She has also deposed that the accused and she have settled their disputes.
11. CW-2 was examined as PW-2 Somashekhar .
He has deposed in his examination in chief that CW-1 is his daughter.
The Accused No.1 is his son in law.
The marriage of CW-1 was performed with Accused No.1 on 01-11-2012 at Ambika Kalyana mantapa, Kengeri.
After a year of marriage, CW-1 gave birth to a female child.
Later Accused did not visit his daughter.
In the year 2014 his daughter went back to the accused, Accused No.1 did not allow as she gave birth to female child.
After a panchayath by CW-4  7  C.C.No.29460/2018 and her husband, he sent his daughter to the house of the accused.
Accused had put conditions as CW-1 should not go to her parents house.
PW-2 further deposed in his examination in chief that in the year 2017 Accused had sent CW-1 for delivery to the Sandhya vs Muralidhar.K.G

on 4 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/149944323/
5 house of CW-6.
On 2-7-2017 CW-1 delivered a female child.
After birth of child CW-1 along with CW 1 and 5 went to house of accused, at that time Accused have abused CW-1 and did not allow her to come to house of accused.
During her cross examination he has turned fully hostile to the case of the prosecution and denied his entire chief examination allegation.
He has also deposed that the accused and they have settled their disputes.
12. CW-3 was examined as PW-3 Chandravathi.
She has deposed in her examination in chief that CW-1 is her daughter.
The marriage of CW-1 was performed with Accused No.1 on 01-11- 2012.
After one year of marriage, CW-1 gave birth to a female child.
Later Accused No.1 did not visit their house to see CW-1.
In the year 2014 her daughter went to his house, at that time Accused did not allow her as she gave birth to a female child.
After convincing, CW 4 and his husband went and left CW-1 to house of accused .
Accused had put conditions that CW-1 should not go to  8  C.C.No.29460/2018 her parents house.

PW-3 further deposed that in the year 2017,
Accused sent CW-1 for delivery to house of CW-6 .
On 02-07-2017 CW-1 delivered a female child.
In the year 2017 CW-1 came to his house with child, at that time Accused abused CW-1 in filthy language and did not allow her into the house as CW-1 gave birth to female child.
During her cross examination she has turned fully hostile to the case of the prosecution and denied her entire chief examination allegation.

She has also deposed that the accused and Sandhya vs Muralidhar.K.G on 4 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/149944323/
6 she have settled their disputes.
13. On going through the entire evidence on record it can be seen that the PW1 to 3 have supported the case of the prosecution at the time of the chief examination.
However, owing to settlement between the parties they have turned hostile to the case of the prosecution.
It is also stated that both the husband and wife are residing together now happily.
Such being the case when the PW1 to 3 have turned hostile to the case of the prosecution during their cross examination, then their evidence cannot be a base for convicting the accused.
Hence, this court holds that the prosecution has failed to prove its case beyond reasonable doubt.
Accordingly, I answer Point No.1 in the Negative.
14. POINT

For the foregoing reasons, I proceed to pass the following:
 ORDER In exercise of power conferred Under are acquitted of the offences punishable U/s. 498A,323 r/w/s 34 of IPC.
shall be in force for a period of 6 months.
(Dictated to the Stenographer directly on the computer and print out taken by her is verified, corrected & then pronounced by me in the Open Court dated this the 04-06-2025).
(SYED ARFATH IBRAHIM M.) XXXVII ACJM., BENGALURU.
